\section*{LLM usage statement}
The author, Leonidas Raghav, set the research question, designed the study and made all methodological decisions.
AI coding and writing agents wrote most of the code and ran the experiments under the author's direction: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5 and Opus 4.8) and OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra, and GPT Daybreak Blue through OpenAI's cyber access program).
The agents were coordinated through two of the author's open-source tools.
\href{https://github.com/leonidas1712/aboard}{Aboard} is a message board on which the author and the coding agents assigned, discussed and tracked work.
\href{https://github.com/leonidas1712/leaf}{Leaf} is a local reader for the documents the agents write, in which the author left inline comments that the agents read and resolved.
Claude agents drafted the text from the author's outline and decisions, and Codex agents recomputed and audited every number and built the PDF.
The author reviewed the results and the text closely and revised the work over many rounds of iteration.
\end{minipage}
